issues.description: Threshold mismatch for Aufgabe 07: the problem statement requires municipalities with more than 75,000 male or more than 75,000 female inhabitants, but the solution uses 7,500 (missing a zero) in the WHERE clause. This discrepancy will cause the reference solution to return a different set of rows than what the task text specifies and will confuse students and automated tests that expect the 75,000 threshold.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the numeric threshold consistent. Update the solution's WHERE clause to use 75000 (e.g. WHERE einwohner_m > 75000 OR einwohner_w > 75000) so it matches the problem statement — or if the intended threshold is 7,500, correct the problem text to state 7,500. Prefer updating the solution to 75,000 to match the written exercise.
